description_html:
8-Port 10/100Mbps + 3-Port Gigabit Desktop Switch with 8-Port PoE+

TL-SL1311P is a 8-Port 10/100Mbps + 3-Port Gigabit Desktop Switch with 8-Port PoE+.

Just plug and play with PoE Transmission for Surveillance up to 250 m.

The total 65 W PoE power budget for the 8× PoE+ ports opens up a wide range of applications, such as surveillance for offices, dormitories, and small businesses.
